patches.notes: First patch through the launcher: proves the auto-updater works. Patches download by themselves from here on.
Updater upgrade: lets the launcher download big updates in pieces. If the next update shows a download error, close the game and open it again.

full.notes: First Godot build with the launcher built in. Pause menu with graphics settings, Forge mode with phys gun and terrain sculpting, 27 drivable bodies, 52 props, your survivor as a full body, cab view and hop-out fixes.
